body.prompt: The woman shown in the reference images, the same face, tied-back hair, mint fleece and black leggings, moves slowly from Praṇāmāsana, standing with palms together at the chest, into Hasta Uttānāsana, arms raised overhead with a gentle backbend, as one calm breath. Fixed camera, eye level, full body always in frame, feet on the same ground line. A soft dawn sky behind her: deep indigo above fading through dusty rose into a warm ochre haze at the ground line, no clouds, no buildings, first light. Photoreal, her face unchanged and identical to the references, calm editorial pacing.
